purpose: Teach: ふざけ/こだわら/街角/傾ける/間に合っ/ちらっと/町中/見回し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ふざけて、お前の写真、たくさん撮ったな。
lines.en: When we were young, I used to fool around and take so many photos of you.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft gaze backwards in time. Slight smile in the voice — remembering playfulness without returning to it. Warm but distant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。細かいことにこだわらない人だったわよ、若い頃のあなた。
lines.en: Yes. You were so carefree back then — didn't get caught up in details.
lines.style: Tender acknowledgment. Slow, measured pace. Voice has affection layered with time. Not correcting him, meeting him where he is in the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 近所の街角、変わったな。
lines.en: The corners of the neighborhood — they've changed so much.
lines.style: Quiet observation, turning inward. Pause-weight on the recognition of time passing. Eyes tracking the differences. Not sad, just noting what isn't anymore.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 写真、首を傾けるポーズ、お気に入りだったね。
lines.en: You had a favorite — that photo where I'd tilt my head just so.
lines.style: Soft, almost conspiratorial warmth. Voice brightens slightly, recalling the small gesture. Gentle emphasis on the memory, not the pose itself. Shared secret between them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 結婚式、何とか間に合った、覚えてる?
lines.en: Do you remember? We barely made it in time for the wedding.
lines.style: Quieter now, checking if the memory lives in both of them. Slight upward lift at the end — inviting him to confirm. Tender urgency underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 玄関、ちらっと、覗くだけで、雰囲気変わるね。
lines.en: Just peeking in through the entryway changes the whole feeling, doesn't it?
lines.style: Observant, present-moment focus. Eyes moving from threshold to room. Voice has a small, genuine discovery in it — noticing what she's seeing right now alongside the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 町中の景色、若い頃と全然違うな。
lines.en: The whole town center looks so different from how it was when we were young.
lines.style: Echo of his earlier thought, but from her side. Matching his wistfulness with her own. Slow, weighted with the distance of decades. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お庭、見回しながら、二人で歩きましょう。
lines.en: Come on — let's walk around the garden together and take it all in.
lines.style: Gentle invitation, reaching for his hand with her voice. Warm, present, and grounded. The shift from memory to now — not leaving the past behind, just moving forward through it together.
